Forrest Bowers, Acting Director

Doug Vincent-Lang, Commissioner

Region I, Petersburg Area Office Petersburg, AK 99833

Advisory Announcement For Immediate Release: August 20, 2026

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

CONTACT: Troy Thynes Region I Management Coordinator troy.thynes@alaska.gov (907) 772-3801

SOUTHEAST ALASKA SALMON PURSE SEINE FISHERY ANNOUNCEMENT

District 1

The following area will be open to purse seining from 6:00 a.m., Saturday, August 22, through 9:00 p.m., Sunday, August 23, 2026:

Section 1-F: will be open south and east of a line from California Head at 55°19.57′ N lat, 131°29.07′ W long to Spire Island Reef Light at 55°16.08′ N lat, 131°29.98′ W long to a point located on the western shore of Gravina Island at 55°20.88′ N lat, 131°51.94′ W long (located on the westernmost tip of an unnamed island immediately south of Grant Cove), then due west to the District 2 boundary line with the following restrictions:

Boca de Quadra: will be closed east of a line from Quadra Point at 55°05.15′ N lat, 130°59.10′ W long to Kah Shakes Point at 55°04.26′ N lat, 130°58.80′ W long;

Carroll Inlet: will be closed north of the latitude of California Head at 55°19.57′ N lat;

Nichols Passage: will be closed north of the latitude of the southernmost tip of Dall Head at 55°07.75′ N lat;

Thorne Arm: will be closed north and east of a line from Moth Point at 55°15.92′ N lat, 131°19.69′ W long to the northernmost tip of Cone Point at 55°14.91′ N lat, 131°19.04′ W long.

District 2

The following area will be open to purse seining from 6:00 a.m., Saturday, August 22, through 9:00 p.m., Sunday, August 23, 2026:

District 2: will be open south of the latitude of the southern entrance of Windfall Harbor at 55°36.03′ N lat with the following restrictions:

Moira Sound: will be closed west of the longitude of the easternmost entrance of Menefee Anchorage at 132°00.35′ W long;

Cholmondeley Sound: will be closed south of 55°15.00′ N lat;

Cleveland Peninsula: will be closed within 2.0 nautical miles (nmi) of the mainland shoreline;

Kasaan Bay, Skowl Arm, Twelve Mile Arm, and contiguous waters: will be closed west of the longitude of Skowl Point Light at 132°16.18′ W long.

District 3

The following area will be open to purse seining from 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Saturday, August 22, 2026:

Section 3-A: will be open with the following restrictions:

Dall Island Shore: will be closed west of a line from the southernmost tip of Reef Point at 55°03.62′ N lat, 132°58.33′ W long to Shoe Island Light at 54°57.07′ N lat, 132°44.68′ W long to the westernmost tip of Datzkoo Point at 54°43.80′ N lat, 132°41.83′ W long and within 0.25 nmi of the eastern shore of Dall Island north of the latitude of Eolus Point at 55°08.38′ N lat;

Eek Inlet: will be closed within 0.2 nmi of the western shore of Hetta Inlet north of the latitude of Eek Point Light at 55°08.27′ N lat and south of 55°09.33′ N lat,

Hetta Inlet: will be closed north of 55°12.00′ N lat;

Hetta Lake Cove: will be closed within 0.3 nmi of the eastern shore of Hetta Inlet north of 55°09.28′ N lat and south of 55°10.62′ N lat;

Hassiah Inlet and Mabel Bay: will be closed east of 132°35.00′ W long and south of the latitude of the northern tip of Helen Island at 54°59.43′ N lat;

Kassa Inlet: will be closed east of the longitude of Kassa Point at 132°31.62′ W long;

Klakas Inlet: will be closed north of 54°57.17′ N lat;

Max Cove: will be closed south of 54°57.17′ N lat;

Sukkwan Strait: will be closed west of 132°46.66′ W long.

Section 3-B: will be open west of a line from Bay Point at 55°42.47′ N lat, 133°29.52′ W long to the northernmost tip of St. Philip Island at 55°39.31′ N lat, 133°25.16′ W long to the northernmost tip of Blanquizal Point at 55°37.36′ N lat, 133°23.86′ W long to the southern tip of Blanquizal Point at 55°37.10′ N lat, 133°23.23′ W long to the northernmost tip of Point Santa Rosalia at 55°34.20′ N lat, 133°24.74′ W long then south to the westernmost tip of Madre de Dios Island at 55°23.63′ N lat, 133°09.67′ W long to Point Bataan at 55°22.89′ N lat, 133°11.11′ W long with the following restrictions:

Portillo Channel: will be closed north of a line from the southernmost tip of Point Amargura at 55°27.00′ N lat, 133°21.64′ W long to Arrecife Point at 55°26.93′ N lat, 133°25.90′ W long and south of a line from the northernmost tip of Point Animas at 55°32.04′ N lat, 133°27.35′ W long to Point Delgada at 55°30.81′ N lat, 133°28.76′ W long;

Ulloa Channel: will be closed south of a line from the northernmost tip of Point Cangrejo at 55°20.80′ N lat, 133°21.42′ W long to the westernmost tip of Point Providence at 55°21.55′ N lat, 133°16.15′ W long.

Section 3-C: will be open with the following restriction:

Holbrook Arm, Van Sant Cove, and contiguous waters: will be closed north and west of a line from Limestone Point Light at 55°56.31′ N lat, 133°36.96′ W long to the southernmost tip of Holbrook Point at 56°00.30′ N lat, 133°28.64′ W long.
